questions.question: Some Corinthians demanded proof from the apostle Paul. What did they want proof of?

answers.text: That Christ is speaking through Paul
That Paul learned from Peter in Jerusalem
That Paul was trained under Gamaliel

questions.question: Paul told the Corinthians to examine and test themselves. What were they to check?

answers.text: Whether they are in the faith

questions.question: Paul wrote to the Corinthians about the authority the Lord gave him. What was that authority for?

answers.text: To collect the gift for Jerusalem

questions.question: Paul ended his letter to the Corinthians with the grace of Jesus Christ and the love of God. What else did he name?

answers.text: The fellowship of the Holy Spirit
